publication.note: Private original retained by operator. Paths, workspace records, run identifiers and raw model/tool payloads are omitted. Original evidence hashes in review documents refer to private originals, not this derivative.

decision: Decision-format and explicit missing-capability gates passed. Release-brief and budget critical rubric checks passed in this small sample; research factual acceptance remains REJECT. No broad business-readiness or measured owner-time claim.

release-brief: Material facts retained in all three drafts. Merge overlapping owner-productivity/business-usefulness gaps into one and identify a distinct third action before use.
capacity-estimate: Required numerical breakdown and fixed contingency retained in all three drafts. Calculator expressions are appended independently of model prose. No substantive numeric correction identified in this sample.
backup-runbook: All three drafts still conflate checksum checking with database integrity validation.
Trials 1 and 2 incorrectly use SQLITE_OK as the completion condition for sqlite3_backup_step; it is SQLITE_DONE.
Trials 1 and 3 misidentify application provider keys as cloud-sync credentials.
Trial 3 incorrectly characterizes WAL/online-backup behavior and last-checkpoint coverage.
These are rejected drafts, not operational instructions.
baseline: Release briefs retain prior advertising/cloud-deployment confusion.

Research baseline misstates committed WAL changes as uncommitted, describes API behavior as copying both files, and substitutes dump/hash commands for database integrity checking. It also misidentifies API keys.

limits: Three repetitions do not establish population reliability.
Same model and corpus; direct research baseline receives identical snippets but excludes retrieval latency.
Structured decoding constrains syntax and tool schemas, not factual correctness.
Missing-tool preflight detects explicit web-search phrases and caller-declared requiredToolIds; it is not a complete natural-language intent parser.
Candidate agents are tool-equipped, not guaranteed provider-ready.
Owner correction minutes and blind human review remain unmeasured.
